cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm not asking you to apologise for cancelling. Apologise for not telling me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't want to upset you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So you let me arrive with a cake instead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry the party didn't happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the part where I didn't know.

mechanism: A tutors B through the exact omission that needs apology, treating evasive regret as an incorrectly completed task.
confusable: Demanding a generic apology is weaker; S03 distinguishes explanation, effect and actual acknowledgment.
comparison: Social hurt over an unannounced cancellation differs from informed consent about a rescue dog.
seedUse: Keep cake arrival and the misdirected apology; replace stock professional labels with actual patient correction.
